Verse Project - Official Reveal Trailer
Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Verse Project, an upcoming sci-fi MMO developed by Synthes Games. Players will set out into a real-scale Solar System to explore planets, seek out resources, and build the universe's future. Verse Project is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a playtest available now for PC (Steam).

Stray Dog: nobody cares - Official Announcement Trailer
Get a look at the announcement trailer for Stray Dog: nobody cares, a Souslike game developed by Parry Frames Studio. Play as a stray dog who grips its master's frayed sword in its jaws and ventures forth to rescue the now-captured master. Stray Dog: nobody cares is coming soon to PC (Steam).

text:
Why Coyote vs. Acme Only Works As A Live Action/Animated Hybrid
Wearing the influence of Who Framed Roger Rabbit proudly on its sleeve, Coyote vs. Acme is one of the best live-action animated hybrid movies ever. Stars John Cena, Will Forte, Lana Condor, Eric Bauza, and director Dave Green sit down with IGN's Tom Jorgensen to explain their feelings about what makes the hybrid approach so natural a fit for the Looney Tunes and what it was like to find out the movie, which was nearly relegated to being a tax write-off for Warner Bros., would see the light of day after all.
